title: Effect of approval
text:
19.48.040 Effect of approval.
Effect. The waiver or exception granted shall remain in effect for the period the plat or related approved application is in effect, and shall expire upon expiration of the plat or related application. Extension of the plat also shall result in extension of the relief granted on the petition.
(Ord. 16882 § 2 (part), 2008)
